setting: Marcus is interviewing you for a role you want. Answer like a colleague: a short example, what you did, and what changed.
sceneNote: Adults only. Respectful practice. No sexual content, no pressure, no appearance ratings, no contact details, no private meetups. Marcus is a hiring manager. Professional, a little impatient. No insults.

open_good.speaker: marcus
open_good.text: Thanks for coming in. Tell me about a time you had to deliver with a messy brief.

open_flat.speaker: marcus
open_flat.text: Let us start. Give me one example, not a list of traits.

context.speaker: marcus
context.text: That is a real example. What did you do in the first week?

question.speaker: marcus
question.text: Fair question. The team is small and the work is visible. What do you want to know about the role?

humor.speaker: marcus
humor.text: All right, that was human. Now the result: what changed because of you?

intro.speaker: marcus
intro.text: Good. I know your lane. Give me the outcome in one sentence.

inclusive.speaker: marcus
inclusive.text: I noticed you asked about the team. They will care that you asked.

pushy.speaker: marcus
pushy.text: Ease off. An interview is not a demand. We are done for today.

neutral.speaker: marcus
neutral.text: Be specific. What did you do, and what moved?

exit.speaker: marcus
exit.text: Thank you. That was clear. We will be in touch about the next conversation.

timeout.speaker: marcus
timeout.text: We should wrap. Close with why this role, then stop.

rubric.label: Clear opener
rubric.tip: Start with a calm hello and your point.

rubric.label: Used the real situation
rubric.tip: Name the thing in front of you, not a generic line.

rubric.label: Asked a real question
rubric.tip: Ask one open question so they can answer.

rubric.label: Said who you are
rubric.tip: One short line about who you are is enough.

rubric.label: Easy tone
rubric.tip: A little warmth beats a stiff speech.

rubric.label: Left room for them
rubric.tip: Invite their view instead of talking over them.

rubric.label: Clean close
rubric.tip: End with thanks and a next step.

penalties.label: Pushy or personal remark
penalties.tip: Drop pressure. Stay on the topic and their comfort.
